title: Xstrata Coal Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of Resource Pacific Holdings Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: On 5 December 2007, Xstrata Coal Pty Limited announced its intention to acquire all issued and outstanding shares in Resource Pacific Holdings Limited.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the relevant markets to be the national market for the supply of thermal coal and the national market for the supply of metallurgical coal.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Factors which led to this conclusion included: - the presence of a number of alternative suppliers of thermal and metallurgical coal including Rio Tinto, BHP Billiton, Peabody Energy Corporation and Anglo American; and - that coal prices were largely determined by Japanese spot markets, limiting the potential for unilateral and coordinated coal price rises.
